definitions.full: H2801. charath [ חָרַת ] verb grave, engrave , only Qal Passive participle הַלֻּחֹת עַל חָרוּת Exod 32:16 (E), engraved upon the tablets . (by finger of God), but from absence of || in cognate languages (Arabic is perforate, bore, slit ) probably error for חָרוּשׁ ( Jer 17:1 ).
